annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2023/2113 of 3 October 2023 on critical technology areas for the EU's economic security for further risk assessment with Member States
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2023/2113 of 3 October 2023 on critical technology areas for the EU's economic security for further risk assessment with Member States
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Recommendation identifying 10 critical technology areas for EU economic security and prioritising four (semiconductors, AI, quantum, biotechnology) for collective risk assessment with Member States by end-2023. Robotics and autonomous systems (drones, vehicles, robots) are listed in the Annex but not prioritised for the initial assessment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four areas prioritised for collective risk assessment by end-2023: advanced semiconductors, AI, quantum, biotechnologies.
Selection criteria: enabling/transformative nature, civil-military fusion risk, human rights misuse risk.
Annex lists 10 areas including Robotics and Autonomous Systems (drones, vehicles, robots).
Guiding principles: systemic vulnerabilities, not country-specific, EU-wide effects, private sector input, confidentiality.
Assessment does not prejudge measures; any measures must be proportionate and precisely targeted.
